sources.note: Town of Reading, 'Elected Officials March 2026' table (the town's official post-meeting officers table): Trustees of Public Funds are Gary Vittum (2027, already recorded), an open seat (2028), and Curt Allen (2029). Allen is minted elected.

Town of Reading, 'Elected Officials March 2026' table (the town's official post-meeting officers table): Cemetery Commissioners are Adam Kozlowski (2027, already recorded), Susan Goodhouse (2028), and an open seat (2029). Goodhouse is minted elected.

Town of Reading, 'Elected Officials March 2026' table (the town's official post-meeting officers table): the library table's legend reads '( R) = Resigned ( A) = Appointed': Libbet Downs (2026), Vanessa Maxham - R (2027), Rich Grogan - A (2027), Janet Malcolm - R (2028), Kristen Hurd - A (2028), Heather Evans (2029, already recorded), Bill Bakker (2030). Grogan and Hurd are the appointed successors to the resigned Maxham and Malcolm seats (the departed members' memberships are ended in this sweep, disclosed); Bakker is minted elected to the 2030 seat. Downs's expired 2026 seat has no published successor and stays open.

Town of Reading, 'Elected Officials March 2026' table (the town's official post-meeting officers table): the same table lists the Town Clerk and Town Treasurer under 'Town of Reading Hired Positions': Calista Brennan holds both offices as an appointee (the town converted both offices to appointed under 17 V.S.A. sections 2651e/2651f).

Town of Reading, 'Elected Officials March 2026' table (the town's official post-meeting officers table): Calista Brennan holds the Town Treasurer office as an appointee under 'Town of Reading Hired Positions' (see the clerk entry).
